name: Adam Grosman
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I believe that your body and mind are working from the same place. I am very curious about how your relationships and life have affected the way your mind and body are organised. My expertise is in working both verbally and physically so that you can re-evaluate your relationship to yourself and decide what works for you, and what doesn't.
specialties: Sex and sexual issues, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Lana Sciberras
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a Clinical Psychotherapist initially trained in Gestalt psychotherapy and mindfulness with a Process-oriented psychological approach (Processwork). My work is always in collaboration with my clients exploring at depth their process of change in a way that assists an emerging self that is both healing and strengthening, resulting in new ways to be in relationship with self, others and life. I use a compassionate approach that includes my training in Self-compassion therapy and Compassion Focused Therapy.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Michelle Date
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Charlotte Hobbs
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Nepean Counselling Services is dedicated to supporting individuals, couples, and families to work through personal difficulties and create meaningful, lasting change. Our focus is on helping clients improve their wellbeing, relationships, and overall quality of life. The principal clinical counsellor, Charlotte, works collaboratively with clients to support healing, insight, and growth.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

name: Helen Meyer
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: As a counsellor I am also Director of Stairway Counselling which offers counsellors and psychologists covering a range of services to the general community.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

name: Aicha Brogan
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Aicha is a Somatic Psychotherapist trained in Gestalt Psychotherapy, Somatic Experiencing (SE) and EMDR with a Masters in Counselling. She uses regulating touch work for early trauma and integrates somatic, mindfulness, attachment and trauma-informed approaches into her work.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

name: Shivon Barresi
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Shivon is a qualified and experienced Clinical Counsellor with a child and adolescent specialisation. She is also a Registered Clinical Family Therapist with the Australian Association of Family Therapy. She has a broad range of experience in providing support to children, adolescents, young people, and families in various contexts such as education, community health services, and private practice.
